description: Create a new video project folder from a template (showtime.json + index.html + assets). Edit its index.html to make the video, then call render. Templates: dom (HTML motion graphics, 16:9), short (vertical social), data (animated charts), film (canvas), tutorial (app walkthrough), series (episodes), showreel (a dense 15 s motion reel: shader, particles, 3D, kinetic and glitch type). tone: showreel for a showreel, hype reel or "go all out" brief. mode: quality (the default: every finished video gets the full review, and qa says "review pending" until a critic round has a verdict) or lean (a cheaper draft pass, only when the user asks for a quick draft: no critic round unless publish-bound).

dir.description: new project folder (must not exist or be empty); relative paths are under the project folder

duration.description: length in seconds; every scene, the poster and the music are rescaled

look.description: look signature for dom, launch, short or data: auto (default: picked away from recent looks), template (the template's own look) or an id (`showtime signature`); a brand kit wins

mode.description: review mode: quality (default, full review with a critic round before delivery) or lean (draft pass; only when the user asks for a quick or cheap draft)

size.description: exact frame size WxH, e.g. 1280x720 (overrides aspect)

storyboard.description: a storyboard from another tool: a Markdown table (Shot | Length | Visual | Narration) or a storyboard.json; one scene per shot (DOM templates; not with duration), its narration as narration.md

tone.description: tone preset (showtime.json "tone", references/tones.md). showreel: a showreel, hype reel or "go all out" brief (flash words allowed, 12-14 shots per 15 s, a ~1 s end card, no shot twice, the showreel critic rubric); default turns it off

name: new_project
title: Create a video project
